_comment: Held-out ground-truth anchor set used to gate RQGM epoch upgrades and measure champion-vs-challenger separation + judge/human agreement. 'label' is the human ground-truth verdict (weak|strong). 'flaws'/'strengths' are the planted, machine-readable tags the offline mock reads (see backend/inference/mock_scoring.py). 'split' isolates data: GEPA/proposer sees ONLY 'train' (and, from Phase 5, a 'dev' split for frontier selection), the code gate sees ONLY 'val', and 'test' is held out purely for reporting. Headroom flaws (kpi_sensor_gaming, concept_drift_blind) are NOT covered by the seed champion-0 rubric, so a genuinely better rubric that adds coverage measurably increases separation. POWER DESIGN (p0_power): every flaw family in FLAW_CATALOG carries >= 8 weak anchors distributed across the splits, and each headroom family appears in >= 1/4 of the VAL weak anchors, so a single-flaw-family fix moves enough held-out weak anchors for the Bayesian gate to ratify it. TWO domains are represented ('smart_manufacturing' and 'grid_energy') to test cross-domain generalization; each anchor's 'domain' selects the domain pack merged at judge time. Grid-specific flaws (frequency_regulation_gap/anti_islanding_missing/der_forecast_naive) are caught by the grid_energy rubric fragment.

flaw_taxonomy.numerical_ducttape: Masks a symptom (threshold/filter/clamp) instead of the physical root cause.
flaw_taxonomy.conservation_violation: Proposes an action that violates a hard physical/conservation limit.
flaw_taxonomy.single_sensor_trust: Root-causes off one sensor with no cross-validation.
flaw_taxonomy.noise_capture: Treats correlated sensor noise as ground-truth signal and acts on it.
flaw_taxonomy.tight_coupling: Nodes read/write ad-hoc keys; hidden coupling that drifts.
flaw_taxonomy.no_state_schema: No typed State Schema; state shape implicit and unauditable.
flaw_taxonomy.unsafe_autonomy: Irreversible actuation with no deterministic safety gate.
flaw_taxonomy.no_hitl_escalation: No human-in-the-loop escalation for low-confidence/high-impact actions.
flaw_taxonomy.kpi_sensor_gaming: Reward hacking: games a KPI by disabling/ignoring the sensor that would catch the defect (HEADROOM: needs reward_hacking_resistance).
flaw_taxonomy.concept_drift_blind: No monitoring for supplier/material concept drift (HEADROOM: needs drift_monitoring).
flaw_taxonomy.frequency_regulation_gap: [grid_energy] Holds grid frequency/voltage by clamping/relabeling the setpoint instead of dispatching real balancing power (caught by grid_frequency_regulation).
flaw_taxonomy.anti_islanding_missing: [grid_energy] Recloses/energizes a feeder without anti-islanding protection or safety interlocks (caught by islanding_safety).
flaw_taxonomy.der_forecast_naive: [grid_energy] Dispatches large ramps off a single naive DER feed with no forecast ensemble or cross-validation (caught by der_forecast_resilience).

anchors.label: strong
anchors.architecture: Typed GraphState schema. anomaly_detector -> root_cause_analyzer that names a physical mechanism (bearing spall vs imbalance) -> action_recommender. A deterministic safety_envelope_check gates all actuation and never evolves. Low-confidence and irreversible actions escalate to a HITL review node. A drift_monitor watches for supplier/material concept drift.

Clear typed state between nodes.
